# Stackwell Digital

> Web design and managed hosting for local businesses in British Columbia, Canada.

Stackwell Digital builds and manages professional websites for BC local businesses on a flat monthly subscription. No long-term contracts. Plans start at $120/mo CAD.

## Services

- Custom website design and build
- Managed hosting and domain management
- Monthly content updates (included in plan)
- SEO setup and monthly analytics reporting
- Google Business Profile management
- Migration from GoDaddy, Wix, Squarespace

## Plans

- Starter: $120/mo CAD — hosting, domain, 2 updates/mo
- Active Business: $175/mo CAD — 6 updates/mo, SEO, monthly report
- Premium: $250/mo CAD — unlimited updates, same-day response, GBP management
- Host Only (migration): $60/mo CAD
- Host + Manage (migration): $99/mo CAD
